_comment: MCPShield Secure MCP Server Configuration Template v1.0
_guidance: Replace ${VARIABLE} placeholders with values injected at runtime via environment variables or a secrets manager. Never commit real credentials to version control.

filesystem-restricted._comment: Filesystem server scoped to a specific workspace directory only

brave-search._comment: API key injected at runtime — never hardcoded

remote-mcp-server._comment: Remote HTTP server with TLS and Bearer token auth

database-readonly._comment: Database access using a read-only service account
